Verlag Ute Fuchs is a small publisher (Jimdo site, Kleingewerbe) whose 'Bilderbuch-Antiquariat' section sells used modern children's picture books by age band, condition 'gebraucht - sehr gut/gut', 6-8 EUR each (e.g. Eric Carle 'Herr Seepferdchen', Hanser 'Der kleine Weihnachtsmann', 'Die kleine Hummel Bommel' by Britta Saggab and Maite Kelly). Outside the specialist antiques scope.

Büchergalerie Westend (Inge Kindermann, M.A., Kazmairstr. 77, 80339 München; Joomla/VirtueMart webshop) is primarily a new-book Buchhandlung that recently opened an adjunct 'neues Antiquariat' at Kazmairstraße 65. juston.com redirects to https://www.juston.com/, the site of JustOn, a Salesforce billing and invoicing software product (invoice management, e-invoicing, cash management, DATEV connector). It is not an antiques, vintage or art retail business; the lead's 'Juston, Jena vintage furniture' snippet does not belong to this domain.

STUFF Loft (stuffloft.de redirects to www.stuffloft.de): manufacturer and interior-design supplier of 'Handmade Altholz Möbel im vintage und industrial Style' (newly built furniture from recycled wood), custom 'Gastronomie und Projekteinrichtung', 'Ladenbau Nonfood', hotel and restaurant fitting, catalogues and an online shop at the separate stuff-shop.de. Newly produced industrial/shabby-chic style furniture and decor, not antiques or genuine vintage; out of scope under the new-goods rule.

Versandantiquariat K. Rehm, Minna-Herzliebstr. 69, Görlitz (WooCommerce shop, 749 priced single books/prints, Kleinunternehmer, no shop premises, tel. 03581 8787460, info@antiquariat-rehm.de). Self-description 'Seltenes, Kurioses und Vergriffenes ... der letzten vier Jahrhunderte' and some genuine antique items (e.g. 7 copper engravings by Martin Engelbrecht c. 1740, EUR 1,550), but a sample of 93 dated catalogue entries across 7 listing pages shows only 2 items before 1800 and 12 in 1800-1899, 29 in 1900-1944, versus 19 in 1945-1979 and 31 from 1980 onward (e.g. a 1994 science textbook, 1985 exhibition catalogues, cheap 'Schmökerpakete' of Modernes Antiquariat), i.e. a mixed used-book trade. Whether the antiquarian share is substantial enough to qualify needs an owner/scope decision; facts for onboarding were not collected. Cart add-to-cart links were not followed.

Imprint (Joomla site at www.bibliotheca-botanica.de): Bibliotheca Botanica, Inhaber Christoph Lankheit, Bergstraße 1, 21365 Adendorf, tel. +49 4131 6086356, USt-IdNr. published, 'Reines Versandantiquariat. Besuche nach Vereinbarung möglich'. Genuine owner-run Fachantiquariat for garden and botany books ('Antiquarische Gartenbücher'), but the dealer's own domain publishes no catalogue: the book stock is searched and ordered only in the hosted merchant storefront on the antiquariat.de origin (shop.jsp?x=29831146, 'Bestände der Bibliotheca Botanica', thousands of titles by subject), reached by an outgoing link and not embedded under the dealer's own domain. A general marketplace origin is not a dealer source; stock available only on a marketplace is an owner decision case. The age mix of the stock (antiquarian versus modern used garden books) was not assessed.

Imprint: Antiquariat partes antiquares, Inhaber Michael Jurk, Heubnerstraße 33, 06886 Lutherstadt Wittenberg, tel. 01774995821, michael.jurk@partes-antiquares.de, USt-IdNr. published. The shop premises closed in the second half of 2023; the business continues as a smaller mail-order Antiquariat whose 'Angebotsspektrum umfasst nun Fachbücher aller Art' plus book-binding work. The dealer's own domain embeds the antiquariat.de merchant storefront (frame https://www.antiquariat.de/shop.jsp?x=52397635, 884 titles in 68 subject groups, e.g. Regionales 137, Region Wittenberg 72, Handwerk 53, Kinder/Jugendbuch 51, Eisenbahn 37). Read-only searches sorted by year show genuinely old items at the oldest end of several categories (from 1778, 1806 and 1835), but the overall age mix and the share of ordinary used professional books cannot be established without paging the whole stock, and the AGB withdrawal block still names a former shop address and phone (Fleischerstraße 23, 03491 406776). Scope (antiquarian versus general used professional books) unconfirmed, so not onboarded.

bahnbuch.de is a specialist railway-book shop whose main catalogue is new publications ('NEUERSCHEINUNGEN 2026', 'Neuerscheinungen 2025', 'VORANKÜNDIGUNGEN', 'EISENBAHN-KALENDER 2027', new titles at list prices such as EUR 39.80 and EUR 98.00, 'Sonderangebote'), with 'Antiquariat' as just one of the top product groups beside periodicals. New-book retail mixed with used books is not a qualified antique/antiquarian dealer under the owner rule of 2026-11-26 (no vintage/new mixes); the subject (railway literature) is not the issue.

Antiquariat Eva Mönkemöller, Bielefeld (Melanchthonstraße 2, 33615 Bielefeld per the page's map link): 'Ankauf und Verkauf gebrauchter und antiquarischer Bücher - rund 20.000 Titel in drei Verkaufsräumen', where 'insbesondere gebrauchte Bücher, darunter Titel aus den aktuellen Bestsellerlisten in häufig neuwertigem Zustand' are sold. The online shop on the sibling host shop.antiquariat-bielefeld.de (3,138 books) offers ordinary used modern books at EUR 4.50-8.00 (novels of 2016-2023, 1986 and 2001 reprints); see the decision recorded for that host. General second-hand book trade, not qualified antiquarian stock.

Antikhandel Stuttgart main site: family-run Juwelier- und Antiquitätenhandel advertising Schmuck-Ankauf, Postankauf, Haushaltsauflösungen/Entrümpelung, 'An- und Verkauf von Antiquitäten, Gold- und Silberschmuck', viewing by appointment only. Its Shopify shop on shop.antikhandel-stuttgart.de (see the decision recorded for that host) is a general catalogue of 500+ items led by modern gold/silver jewellery and coins, with new or unused goods ('NEU ... in OVP und UNBENUTZT'), electronics, fan articles and a Räumungsverkauf next to some antiques. General second-hand/house-clearance and precious-metal trade, not a specialist antique dealer under the owner rules.

MB-Antik (Mario Bock, Kopfweidenstr. 26, 59075 Hamm; Kleinunternehmer) is a Wix business-card site: buying (Ankauf at the customer's home, per-kilo prices for tin/silver/brass), house-clearance and valuation services and a commission house flea-market service. The only sales channel named is a Facebook page ('Facebook-Shop'); the website itself lists no itemised or priced stock (categories such as militaria, coins, tin, vintage furniture are listed as buy/sell interests only). No inspectable own-stock catalogue and no checkout on the first-party site; auction and contemporary-art check: none.

Antiquitäten- & Kunsthandel Tellmann (Mönchengladbach) presents a one-page business-card site for buying gold, precious metals, jewellery, watches, porcelain and art ('Ankauf', 'Anfrage stellen'); the page has no sales catalogue, no priced items and no shop. Auction and contemporary-art check: none.
Antik Lokales is a restaurant and beer garden in Darmstadt-Eberstadt (menu, Lieferando delivery, Christmas garden); it has no antiques or art stock.

Hermann Straub is primarily a furniture restoration and joinery workshop (since 1951: Kunst- und Antiquitätenschreinerei, Innenausbau, Reparatur, Gartenholz). Its 'Marktplatz / Shop' has a dedicated new-goods part: Holzwaren und Dekoration (hand-turned wooden Easter eggs, stars, chopping boards, door hook rails, EUR 10-12), Heimwerkerbedarf/Möbelpflege and Werkzeug/Maschinen/Material, with only a handful of used furniture teasers (Gründerzeit bedroom, Jugendstil game table) and a note that the first offers are still missing. Restoration service plus new wood goods shop; no qualified antiques catalogue.

Antiquariat Udo Schwörer (Pforzheim; Inhaber Udo Schwörer, Wolfsbergallee 36, 75177 Pforzheim, USt-ID DE159648124) has no own catalogue: its 'WebShop' page only links to its ZVAB seller catalogue (marketplace) and to 'unsere Online-Auktionen bei eBay' (eBay seller account), i.e. it also sells in auction format. Auction-format selling is excluded by the owner policy and the stock is marketplace-hosted only.

Antiquariat Minx (Berlin-Kreuzberg and Bücherstadt Wünsdorf) is a general used-book trade: 'über 250.000 gebrauchte Bücher', stock browsed in shelves and crates (Literatur, Geschichte, Philosophie, Kinderbücher, ...). The website has no catalogue of its own; online stock is searched on buchfreund.de (marketplace), records 'nebenbei'. No qualified antiquarian/antique stock evidenced.

EYECATCHER exklusive Interieurs (Inh. Anja Aehlig, Rothenburger Straße 11, 01099 Dresden) runs a WooCommerce shop with antique furniture and chandeliers next to a large 'Wohnaccessoires' range that is newly made decor and gifts: Windlicht 'Gotik'/'Gold'/'Fein', Origami stars in bone china, capiz Christmas stars, Venetian mirrors, 'Vase peacock', 'perfektes Bad', 'Superbüro', seasonal X-MAS gifts, plus a Möbelanfertigung/Möbelaufbereitung service. Dedicated new-goods/decor section well above the trivial share.

Englische Möbel (family business since 1982) sells English style furniture, with a dedicated 'Reproduction Kollektion' (Sheraton sideboard, waterfall bookcase, wine table, lamp table, 'Made in England' Chesterfield sofas with configurable Standard/Federkern prices) and a separate eBay shop next to originals. Newly made reproductions are a dedicated catalogue section.

Appretur Kaiserbrecht (Johannes Mayer, An der Obermühle 1, 02826 Görlitz) is a one-page site for restoration and upholstery ('Restaurierung & Polsterei', 'Anfrage'); the 'Sammlung' shows four illustrative tiles (Apothekerschrank, Industrie Lampe, Polsterarbeiten, Antiquitäten) without itemised, priced stock or a shop. No inspectable own-stock catalogue.

Vintagewerft (Eisenach) states 'Upcycling ist unsere Leidenschaft', 'mehr als nur ein Second Hand Möbel-Laden' and offers shabby chic, Landhaus, retro and industrial furniture plus interior concepts for shops and offices; the WordPress site has no itemised or priced catalogue (Instagram feed and a 'Vintage Loft' page only). Upcycling/second-hand decor without an inspectable qualified stock.

Style Deco (Inhaberin Beate Hornik, Kurfürstenstr. 15, 80799 München, USt-IdNr. DE130455840) shows genuine Art Deco/Bauhaus/mid-century lamps, furniture and design in photo galleries (e.g. table lamps 'Hydra, France, 1970s', 'Art Deco Table Lamp, France, 1930s') but publishes no prices, no cart, no order terms and no shipping information on any inspected page (home, categories, tischleuchten, service, kontakt, impressum: no EUR amounts, Preis, Versand or AGB). Showroom by appointment/opening hours. No inspectable priced stock; auction and contemporary-art check: none.

Rheinstore (Michael Krämer, Melchiorstr. 34, 50670 Köln) is a showroom for 'gebrauchte Designmöbel' of the complete 20th century with a WordPress blog-style listing (about 25 posts; prices only in some, no cart or checkout, current offer 'immer aktuell bei Instagram'). Stock mixes mid-century pieces with used contemporary design and art: Vitra 'Morph' office table (Alberto Meda), Artemide 'Cadmo' floor lamp (Karim Rashid), Moormann table, Panton chair for Ikea 1992, 1985/1988 paintings, Bally pinball 1969, plus An- und Verkauf of second-hand goods. Second-hand modern design above the trivial share and no inspectable online sale.

ART DECO Kai-Marc Regenold (Sophienstraße 26, 76530 Baden-Baden) is a showroom of Art Deco furniture, lamps, objects, Lalique and Christofle. The phpwcms website's 'Galerie' is a photo gallery with item numbers only ('Möbel (240610) Artdeco-Nr: 2000-730'); the detail pages contain no description, price, shop or terms, and the newest entries date from 2024. No inspectable priced stock.

DELFU Vintage (Shopify, 29 products, 26 available) sells mid-century furniture, but about a quarter of the catalogue is altered or upcycled rather than original: 'DIY Kommode Bunt Upcycling Holz Metall', 'Schachbrett Couchtisch | Upcycling | DIY Blumenbank', 'Buntes DDR Regalsystem ... nachhaltig & stilvoll', 'DDR Kommode meets Streetart', 'Wrenger Couchtisch Goes Streetart', 'Dyrlund Teak Kommode meets Streetart', 'Cadovius Kommode im neuen Gewand', plus a used Ekornes Stressless recliner. Restyled/upcycled decor above the trivial share; not a clean vintage stock.

LeclaireDesign (Andreas Leclaire, Werderstr. 35, 19055 Schwerin, USt-IdNr. DE236150886) shows an itemised, priced catalogue of genuine vintage lamps (Art Deco 1930s, 1950s-70s), Danish teak and Thonet-style furniture, but the page is an Etsy Pattern storefront ('Powered by Etsy', contact page: orders alternatively at leclairedesign.etsy.com), so the stock and checkout are marketplace-hosted. The shop profile also says the dealer develops and sells modern wooden furniture (not in the catalogue seen). Marketplace-hosted-only storefront is an owner decision.

Antiquariat Stefan Küpper (Inhaber Stefan Küpper, Aakerfährstr. 49, 47058 Duisburg, USt-ID DE173388348) runs a WordPress/WooCommerce site whose 'Bestand' menu only links to its Booklooker seller listing; the site itself shows no catalogue (shop path answered 503 on retry). Stock is marketplace-hosted only; antiquarian scope of the books is not evidenced either.

The shared website-builder host s888098654.websitebuilder.online answers http with a 301 to https, and the https certificate chain fails verification (unable to get local issuer certificate) on two attempts (fetch.py and curl); no page content, imprint or operator could be read. No TLS bypass.

MGM Münzgalerie München (Münzgalerie München MGM Handelsgesellschaft mbH & Co. Joker KG, Stiglmaierplatz 2, 80333 München, HRA 59787, USt-IdNr. DE130006976; explicit AGB tariffs DE EUR 5 free from EUR 300, rest of EU EUR 9.50 free from EUR 1,000, rest of world EUR 15; Click & Collect) is a JavaScript shop (rendered with headless Chromium) of historic numismatics: 514 Altdeutsche, 721 ancient, 694 foreign coins, 78 German coins from 1871 (Kaiserreich, Weimar, Third Reich), ~450 medals, 101 banknotes. Unresolved scope question: a 'Numismatische Literatur' list of 2,065 reference books (1977-2019, prices such as EUR 29.80/173.90 that look like new list prices, no condition stated, no detail pages), a 'Bullion Münzen' section (5 items incl. 2021), modern medals (Vatican 2014) and the operator also trades precious metals and jewellery (mgm-schmuck.de). Whether new books and bullion exceed the trivial new-goods share cannot be settled from the shop; owner decision on numismatic literature needed. The main domain muenzgalerie.de is already a separate DEFERRED record.

Petite Fantastic - Vintage Interior (Shopify; 60 products, 30 available) offers genuine vintage, mid-century and antique furniture and lamps (Gründerzeit mirror, Jugendstil armchair, GDR lamps). However every legal page (/pages/impressum, /pages/standort, /pages/abholung-lieferung, /pages/datenschutzerklaerung) renders the same AGB text ('Datenschutz Test' in the footer); no real imprint exists. The AGB name only 'Inhaberin: Nadine Reißmann, Halle (Saale)'; the footer shows Helmut-von-Gerlach-Straße 16a, 06112 Halle, a mobile number and an @petiteflohmarkt.de address, and the brand also runs a flea market/creative market. Operator identity and address are not confirmed by a proper legal notice; a few upcycled items and one contemporary photo were also seen. Recheck once the imprint is fixed.

qualification.basis: Sole-proprietor vintage design dealer in Oldenburg (imprint: DEKADEN, Inhaber Malte Wach, Ekernstr. 80b, 26125 Oldenburg, USt-IdNr. DE298657943, Kleinunternehmer; mw@dekaden.com, +49 163 6157737; AGB: contract partner DEKADEN, Malte Wach). WooCommerce store (wp-json store API, 160 products: 35 in stock in 'Collection', 125 sold in 'Archive') with itemised, priced originals, e.g. Fabricius & Kastholm for Bo-Ex sofa and armchair 1960s EUR 6,000; Kristian Vedel Modus fruit bowl 1960s EUR 800; Thonet S34 Mart Stam cantilever chairs EUR 800; Kai Kristiansen wall console for Kjersgaard 1960s EUR 1,100; Hillebrand, Kaiser Leuchten, Stilnovo lamps; Willumsen & Engholm for Fritz Hansen tray table. Style' / 'in the manner of' titles denote unattributed vintage pieces (the Scarpa-style chair page says 'Vintage-Zustand', marked '041'), not reproductions. omissions: Shipping destinations, rates and thresholds are not stated (costs only 'bei den Angeboten'); only the existence of paid shipping and the pickup option are recorded, so no shipping coverage beyond an unresolved destination is asserted.

The warehouse at Langenweg 30 is recorded as WAREHOUSE only (viewings by appointment; the contact page does not call it a showroom); the imprint address is recorded as REGISTERED_ADDRESS and is the AGB pickup address, not asserted as a showroom.
Seller logo is the 200x97 PNG header logo as published (not upscaled).

omissions: Shipping terms are not asserted: the only page ('International Shipping Information') mentions ten years of experience shipping worldwide and an individual offer per item, with no domestic terms, destinations or rates; no pickup rule is stated either (viewing by appointment only).
The 'Über uns' page prints the shop address with postal code 24118 while the imprint and the Widerrufsbelehrung give 24103 for the same street address; the imprint value is recorded.

Giessen Vintage (imprint: Hans Philipp Schmidt, Kapellenstrasse 8, 35394 Giessen, UST-ID DE244900102; showroom/warehouse Ohlebergsweg 13, 35392 Giessen by appointment) sells genuine 1950s-70s mid-century furniture from own stock, but the WordPress site has no own catalogue: the /shop/ page only embeds the dealer's Kleinanzeigen profile ('Aktuelle Angebote', https://www.kleinanzeigen.de/pro/giessenvintage); no WooCommerce products (store API route absent). Retrokaufhaus (imprint: Christiane Schiek-Tajima, Huettenstrasse 2, 50374 Erftstadt, mail@retrokaufhaus.de) is a general retro second-hand shop: its own 'Ueber uns' says it collects 'Schaetze und Schaetzchen' of the 50s-70s, 'ob wertvolle Designklassiker oder einfach nur geliebte Alltagsgegenstaende', including furniture, crockery, lamps, clothing, toys and curiosities, with deliberately cheap prices for first-home furnishers ('neben Schwedenchic'). The WooCommerce catalogue (store API) holds only 14 items at EUR 34-490, mostly undated everyday pieces without maker attribution (old rocking chair 'zum Aufarbeiten', wicker chair, single wooden chair, kitchen chairs 'Green hornet Western', steel 'Industrial/Jailhouse' bed, trolley table, shelving) next to a few 50s-70s teak items and lamps. Plain second-hand retro stock, not a specialist antiques/vintage-design dealer. No auctions seen.

Versandbuchhandlung Maier & Ostmark-Antiquariat (imprint: Franz Maier, Obernried 37, 93494 Waffenbrunn, franz.maier@buecher-maier.de, 09975-8936). The WordPress site is a marketing/category shell: its 'So bestellen Sie' page states it is a pure mail-order antiquarian dealer that sells through abebooks.de (basket, payment and contract run on AbeBooks) and every catalogue link goes to the dealer's AbeBooks shop (vci=61955178). No own inspectable catalogue or checkout. Stock is general used and regional books (Oberpfalz/Niederbayern, plus cooking, crime, music, hobby) and the site also sells the new Straubinger Kalender 2026, so scope would need review anyway. Marketplace-only stock is an open owner decision.

Buchhandlung Weltbuehne (imprint: Helmut Loeven, Gneisenaustrasse 226, 47057 Duisburg, USt-IdNr DE119586505). Orders go by e-mail; the shop states 'wir besorgen jedes lieferbare Buch'. A new-goods bookshop with dedicated new-book, music and video sections is a vintage/new mix and outside the antiques scope. No auctions seen.

Home page (https, http and www/non-www variants) timed out at the TCP connect stage on repeated attempts (fetch.py twice, plus a bounded IPv4 curl retry with an ordinary browser User-Agent; host resolves to 62.138.18.216). The page was never read, so identity, stock and imprint are unverified. Lead note says an antiquarian bookshop in the Moenchengladbach old town; not qualifiable without inspectable pages.

LEJLA'S 'First Vintage & Second Hand' (Liebfrauenstrasse 59, Darmstadt) is a brick-and-mortar second-hand fashion store (women's and men's wear, jeans, sneakers, bags, scarves, jewellery, sunglasses; 'Mode & Accessoires' first) with some used design furniture and lamps, plus a separate 'Concept Store' (Liebfrauenstrasse 55) selling new gifts and home goods, and a commission section. The one-page site has no online catalogue or shop (only gallery/impressum pages, Instagram and phone/WhatsApp contact). General second-hand fashion retail plus a new-goods concept store, not an inspectable antiques/vintage-design dealer.

qualification.basis: Imprint: Antiquariat Clemens Lehmann-Dronke, Inhaber Clemens Lehmann-Dronke, An der Vogelrute 39, 53879 Euskirchen, tel. (02251) 506 88 14, antiquariat@lehmann-dronke.de, USt-IdNr. DE 159634955, member of Boersenverein. AGB: 'Die Buecher sind ihrem Alter entsprechend gut erhalten'. Own stock (a mail-order antiquarian dealer); no new books, auctions, or contemporary art seen on home, category, AGB or shipping pages.

omissions: The contact page's separate 'Paketlieferungen' address (Gottlieb-Daimler-Str. 2b, Euskirchen) is not imported as a location or stock site; no showroom, visitor access or pickup is stated.

No collection stated.
Platform JTL_SHOP from explicit JTL-Shop markers (jtl.basket.js, jtl.evo.js assets, JTL-Shop generator references).

decision.basis: 22ART22 (Munich) describes itself on its home page as an art and vintage shop 'spezialisiert auf Nachkriegs- und zeitgenoessische Kunst sowie Vintage Design des 20. Jahrhunderts': ZERO, Konkrete Kunst and Minimalism, 'renommierte zeitgenoessische ... und aufstrebende akademische Kuenstler:innen', mainly high-quality limited graphics (editions) and vintage photography by living and recently active German, Austrian, Swiss and Italian artists, plus vintage design and art books. Stock is predominantly post-1945 and contemporary art/editions (living artists involved), so it falls under the contemporary/post-war art exclusion rather than the pre-1945 qualification line.

Golfmuseum Regensburg (imprint: Peter Insam, Taendlergasse 3, 93047 Regensburg, +49 941 51074, info@golf-museum.com) is the visitor-museum site of the Antikhaus Insam operator (same Peter Insam and Taendlergasse address; antikhaus-insam.de is already ADDED with its own JTL-Shop). The home page promotes the museum (1,200 golf rarities, not for sale), the Antikhaus and the Domresidenz hotel; it has no sales catalogue of its own and its SHOP menu only links out to the separate golf-antiques.com storefront. Nothing to onboard on this domain; golf-antiques.com is queued as a related lead for the existing operator.

https://www.meyer-antik.de/ and the http/non-www and /index.html variants all return HTTP 200 with a single-word placeholder body ('Buh!') behind Cloudflare; impressum/kontakt paths are 404. The page names no business, operator, address, contact or stock, so the lead's identity (Antiquitaetenhandlung Meyer, St. Martin/Pfalz, taken from directory listing text) cannot be tied to this domain and there is nothing inspectable to qualify.

qualification.basis: Imprint: Art Déco Annette Stern, Einzelunternehmen, Inhaberin Annette Stern, Opelstraße 16, 68789 St. Leon-Rot, +49 172 7751298, info@artdeco-stern.de, USt-IdNr. DE 269 864 666. Home page: 135 m2 showroom in St. Leon-Rot (since October 2025; before that Mannheim/Baden-Baden) with original French Art Deco furniture, lamps and art objects bought personally in France and restored in Germany; a site notice says visits by prior appointment, 'kein Ladengeschaeft'. Own catalogue of 250 objects with detail pages (article number, style, origin, year, dimensions), e.g. bar cart by Robert Mallet-Stevens c. 1925 (nickel-plated brass), Amboina vitrine c. 1925, Art Deco sideboard in Nero Portoro marble and French walnut 1930s, Verlys 'Les Sirenes' vase, Etling vase, Jacques Adnet desk lamp, veneered bedroom suites; all prices 'Preis auf Anfrage'. Catalogue is entirely period originals (restored); the text only mentions made-to-order new pieces as a service and no new, reproduction or contemporary items appear in the catalogue. The dealer buys at French antique markets, auctions and from private owners but runs no auctions of its own; no contemporary art.

omissions: No shipping or collection terms asserted: the site has no Versand/AGB page; visits are by appointment only, and the showroom is explicitly not a walk-in shop.
Platform omitted: custom-built site (own /assets/js/site.js, /images/products/original), no concrete commerce-platform fingerprint.

Catalogue prices are published only as 'Preis auf Anfrage'; the unrestored pieces in the dealer's store room are not located or asserted as a stock site. Second e-mail a.stern@stern-artdeco.de (visit notice) kept as an additional contact. Logo is the dealer's own white SVG wordmark with a teal band (rendered on a contrasting ground for inspection).

decision.basis: Antiquitaeten Voehringer (imprint: Marc Voehringer, Geschaeftsinhaber, Uracher Strasse 1, 72532 Gomadingen, 0174 2 17 75 57, info@antiquitaeten-voehringer.de) is a six-page WordPress brochure site (WP REST page list: home, Antiquitaeten page, cafe, contact, imprint, privacy). The antiques page is mainly about buying (Ankauf of jewellery, silver, watches, coins, furniture, paintings), estate administration and house clearance; the sales side is only a general mention of furniture, art, collectibles, jewellery and watches shown in the Gomadingen exhibition (open Fri-Sun, shared with the dealer's cafe). No catalogue, item, price or photo of stock is published online, so nothing individually offered can be inspected.

erlbachbuch.de redirects to www.erlbachbuch.de, the WordPress brochure site of Erlbachbuch Antiquariat, Matthias Herbig, Schoenhauser Allee 64, 10437 Berlin (imprint: post@antiquariat.berlin, +49 30 4473 0294, USt-ID DE 238 447 180). The same operator, e-mail and phone already own the ADDED listing source antiquariat.berlin (live Party 'Erlbachbuch Antiquariat'). The brochure site has no catalogue of its own: its catalogue page only links to marketplace shops (antiquariat.de / GIAQ, booklooker) and the existing storefront, and the imprint says 'keine Besuchsadresse'. Nothing to add beyond the existing source.

Goldstein & Co. (imprint: Matthias Dietrich e.K., Karl-Liebknecht-Strasse 36, 04107 Leipzig, +49 341 3019008, contact@goldstein-interieur.com; PrestaShop-style shop, redirects to www.goldstein-interieur.com/de/) sells refurbished vintage industrial furniture and lamps, but its own category texts also sell newly built pieces: tables 'in ganz neuem Design' made from reclaimed workbench tops, pallets and cast-iron frames ('Tisch aus unserer Manufaktur'), cabinets 'neu gebaut' from old locker doors and factory windows, and made-to-measure seating and furniture in solid wood and metal. A dedicated 'Massanfertigung' section ('Wir bauen Ihr neues Lieblingsmoebel'), interior projects for shops and restaurants, and upcycled decor sit next to the vintage stock. That is a vintage/new mix (own-made new furniture and upcycling beyond a trivial share), so it is excluded.

BLICKZURUeCK (imprint: Blickzurueck, Annett Spata, Altplauen 19 H, 01187 Dresden, 0351-31469861, info@blickzurueck.com; displayed as blickzurück.de) is a Dresden shop for antiques and design classics with its own workshop, showroom and valuation services. The website itself has no catalogue: it only links 'Zu unserem Angebot bei Kleinanzeigen' (https://www.kleinanzeigen.de/pro/blickzurueckde) and says the furniture and accessories are online at kleinanzeigen.de or in the shop. Stock is therefore only inspectable on a marketplace, an open owner-decision case.

Laekker Vintage e.K. (imprint: Inhaber Hendrik Herzmann, Herbigstr. 4a, 50825 Koeln, HRA 34861 Koeln, USt-ID DE274920250, 0157 75796990; Jimdo site) buys and sells restored 1950s-1980s mid-century furniture and design classics. The Jimdo site (home, About, imprint, legal pages) has no catalogue: 'Unser aktuelles Sortiment' only links to the dealer's Kleinanzeigen profile (https://www.kleinanzeigen.de/pro/laekker-vintage), and offers are otherwise made by WhatsApp. Stock is only inspectable on a marketplace, an open owner-decision case.

Antik-Lauchhammer (imprint: Andreas Frahs, Einzelunternehmen, Tischler, Kostebrauerstr. 2, 01979 Lauchhammer, 03574-46 72 750, antik.lauchhammer@gmx.de; free webme.com site) is a general yard/shop: 1,000 m2 store with 'Antik Laden' (stoneware pots, furniture up to 1925, clocks, jugs, toys, dolls, orders) beside scrap-metal, gold/silver and waste-paper buying, garden/agriculture, animal and DDR-goods sections and spare parts. The site's category pages (Lampen, Uhren, Keramik, ...) contain only a menu and no itemised objects, prices or availability, so no individual stock can be inspected online. General Troedel/scrap trade without an inspectable antiques catalogue.

Gluecksmomente Shabby Market (imprint: Glücksmomente Shabby Market, Hauptstrasse 81, 01587 Riesa; Mareen Tilgner, Am Fussweg 34, 01609 Wuelknitz; 0162/1906928; info@gluecksmomente-shabbymarket.de) is a shabby-chic and French country-house decor shop with a cafe. Home page and online shop offer candles, lanterns, wooden candle holders, cushions, throws, lampshades, magazine racks, tableware, textiles, handbags and gift sets with new-goods shop prices (e.g. candle holder EUR 49.95, throw cushion EUR 34.95), plus 'Vintage-Deko' and furniture in vintage style. Predominantly new decor and gift goods in a vintage look, not genuine antiques; no qualified antique stock is identifiable.

LaVie Wohntrends (imprint: Silke Werner, Huenersdorfstr. 26, 99867 Gotha, +49 173 8862088, lavie.s@t-online.de) is a 'Moebel-Outlet' for new brand furniture and decor in country-house, Scandi and shabby-chic style. The online shop lists newly manufactured goods such as a limited Loberon advent calendar 2025, 'Sessel NASOUR Leinen grau Fernsehsessel' (EUR 349) and garden benches 'im antiken Stil' / 'Vintage' (new reproductions, e.g. iron and stone-style benches), under 'Ausgewaehlte Markenmoebel'. New-goods furniture and decor retail, not genuine antiques or vintage stock.

H&H Lampen, Elektromeister Holger Henschel (Obere Dorfstrasse 4-5, 09618 Brand-Erbisdorf; redirects to www.h-h-lampen.de; shop with its own cart) sells genuine used Jugendstil/Art Deco lampshades and restored antique lamps, but the same shop catalogue has dedicated new-goods sections: 'nachgefertigte Schirme' (replica shades), 'Komplettleuchten - Nachbau' and 'Leuchtengestelle - Nachbau' (reproduction lamps and frames), new porcelain switches (Garby, Garby Colonial), wax-stick holders, plus new Berliner Messinglampen and special-lamp building and lighting planning. A vintage/new mix with dedicated reproduction and new-made sections, so it is excluded.

DE178344033, info@silbersuite.de, Tel. +49 8444 874). New-goods check: all categories are antique silver; the only non-silver 'Varia' rubric (set up for leftover props from magazine photos, offered at cost) shows a single item (a pair of unused hand-made blue glass carafes), far below 5% of stock and not a new-goods shop part. Virtual shop shown only at fairs (Kunst & Antiquitäten München); the imprint address is not claimed as showroom.

omissions: Collection/pickup not stated (virtual shop), omitted.

qualification.basis: Sole-proprietor dealer in original antique prints and historical maps (imprint: 'Le voyage en papier - marc dechow', Inhaber Marc Dechow, Abendrothsweg 55, 20251 Hamburg, USt-ID DE234021339, info@antique-prints.de, +49 40 4204212; AGB name the same Anbieter). Category check: 'Moderne Kunst' holds 86 items (of which post-1945 graphic art 56 items, e.g. a 1994 crayon drawing by Walter Tauchert, a c. 1970 lithograph by Anna Staritsky), roughly 0.5% of the catalogue, so within the trivial share; 'Passepartouts' lists two mount supplies; no new goods, reproductions or auctions found. The imprint address is not claimed as a showroom.

omissions: Collection/pickup not stated, omitted.
Shipping charges depend on quantity and method and are not stated; only the explicit worldwide delivery and 2-working-day dispatch are asserted.

decision.basis: Münzenhandlung Raffler (Marc Raffler, Quellengasse 6, Pfaffenhofen, USt-Id DE334625465) is mainly a coin/precious-metal buying service ('Ankauf von Gold- und Silbermünzen', Hausbesuche, Anlagegold). The own WooCommerce/WordPress site has only a 'Münzen Verkauf' brochure page (no priced catalogue; whole stock held in a bank safe, viewing by appointment); the sister site vindelicorum-raimund-raffler.de links the stock to a MA-Shops storefront (marketplace). Bullion/investment coins are part of the trade and the page also advertises representation at auctions worldwide. No inspectable own-site sales catalogue, so deferred for the owner's marketplace-only decision.

Galerie Ziehn & Dickmeis, Düren (Georg Dickmeis, HRA 728): WooCommerce shop is dominated by new decorative goods and contemporary art: hand-painted polyresin 'Pop Art Skulpturen' (e.g. Balloon Dog EUR 65-212, Material Polyresin/Fiberglas), 'Junge Kunst!' paintings by emerging artists (EUR 159-449), framed Hundertwasser reproductions (EUR 399-649), AluArt, Weihnachtskrippen, plus framing and object-fitting services. Some old icons/prints/silver exist but the shop is a vintage/new mix of new decor, reproductions and living artists.

Teppichhaus Sami, München: oriental rug retailer, wash and repair service. Menu has 'Hell & Fein' ('die neue Generation der Perser-Teppiche', newly knotted modern interpretations), 'Re-Importe', 'Seide & China', 'Klassiker', 'Herstellung' next to a small 'Alt & Antik' collector section; the site is a showroom brochure without a priced online catalogue. New rug retail dominates, so it is a vintage/new mix without inspectable antique stock.

Teppichgalerie Thomas (Vechta; Shopware shop): categories Klassische Teppiche, Orientteppiche, Designteppiche (new Thomas design rugs from India), Moderne Teppiche, Nepalteppiche, Gabbeh, Naturfarbene Teppiche, Replikat Täbris rug and a 'Räumungsverkauf' (closing branch sale -50%) next to a 'Sammlerteppiche' section (20-50, 50-100, over 100 years). New rugs make up most of the catalogue, so it is a vintage/new mix.

Uhland Kunsthandel & Juwelier (Berlin Uhlandstr. 162, Hamburg Papenhuder Straße 42) presents itself purely as a buying service: 'Ankauf von Schmuck, Uhren, Gold, Münzen und Antiquitäten', photo appraisal via WhatsApp/e-mail, house calls, estate clearance; the WordPress site has no sales catalogue, shop or priced stock (all ~85 pages are 'Ankauf' pages for brands and categories).

qualification.basis: Sole-proprietor dealer in antique tiled stoves ('Ofen-Lustig - Antike Kachelöfen und Ofenzubehör', Bernd Lustig, Mühlensteig 14, 14979 Großbeeren OT Diedersdorf, USt-IdNr. DE165887110, +49 171 6439911; e-mail ofen-lustig@gmx.de in the AGB). Online catalogue of 31 numbered restored/unrestored antique stoves c. 1810-1920 (Biedermeier Salonofen c. 1810, Veltener Fünfeckofen c. 1900, Meissner Rundofen c. 1890, Grazer Stadtofen c. 1890, Schwedischer Zylinderofen c. 1890) plus antique stove fronts (Ofenvorlagen), coal scuttles and fire sets with item numbers. Sales only in the Diedersdorf showroom ('Verkaufsausstellung'); the online exhibition is a catalogue and no prices are published; AGB: contract after personal or telephone consultation, delivery by arrangement. Original-faithful restoration of antiques collected across Europe ('Über mich'); no new goods, reproductions, auctions or contemporary art found.

omissions: Showroom street not asserted: the site only says 'Verkaufsausstellung in Diedersdorf bei Berlin' and a map link hints at a different street, so only the imprint address is stored (no BUSINESS_PREMISES claim).
Shipping destinations and prices not stated (delivery by arrangement); collection site omitted.
Platform: MODx named in the imprint only as the CMS used for the site, no commerce platform.

decision.basis: Antik Möbel Grothaus (Andreas Grothaus, Schäferweg 73, 32130 Enger; §25a UStG) is a one-page restoration/showroom business card: texts about restoring antique furniture and an 'Antiquitäten-Ausstellung' with opening hours, but no catalogue, no priced or itemised stock and no product pages anywhere on the site (13 links, only anchors and image credits).

Furniture restoration workshop of Alex Melnik (Markomannenstraße 48, 12524 Berlin) with a side shop listing 14 priced antique pieces (Louis-Philippe Klapptisch c. 1860 EUR 900, Empire Kaminuhr c. 1810 EUR 1,700, Zylinder-Aufsatzsekretär EUR 7,500). The product detail pages render only raw Avada '[fusion_cfield ...]' shortcodes (no description, year, size or price), the contact numbers differ (imprint 0176 422 086 20 vs. (030) 548 452 52 on product pages), no AGB/shipping page ('Liefer-/Versandkosten nach Absprache, Selbstabholung möglich' only) and the business presents itself as a restorer; deferred until the shop is inspectable.

ResAnDes sells salvaged building materials (old bricks, granite slabs, reclaimed boards, windows, doors, roof tiles) next to new products: 'Dreischichtplatten' (new three-layer boards with a 7 mm reclaimed-wood veneer), made-to-order 'Möbel aus Altholz' ('jedes Möbelstück nur auf Bestellung ... gefertigt'), new gifts from old wood (Windlichter, Bilderrahmen, EUR 80) and brick slips cut from old bricks. Building-material salvage plus newly made furniture and gifts, not an antiques/vintage dealer.

Antik-experte.de (Bastian Bartsch, Kunsthistoriker M.A., Parkstraße 17, 80339 München; Jimdo site) is mainly a buying/appraisal and sales-brokerage service: 'Ankauf', 'Ebay-Verkaufservice' (commission 30-40% of the proceeds, he runs the whole sale of third-party goods), commission sale of paintings and mediation of Lange & Söhne pocket watches to collectors. The 'Verkäufe' page points the current offers only to the eBay shop ebay.de/str/antikexperte; the site has no own catalogue. Marketplace-only stock combined with commission brokerage: owner decision (eBay format, auction role, not inspected).

Zisska & Lacher Buch- und Kunstauktionshaus GmbH & Co. KG, München: twice-yearly book and art auctions (Auktion A 88, Versteigerungsbedingungen, online/PDF catalogue, live bidding on live.zisska.de). Auction house.

Autogramm-Shop (hosted shop system) selling mostly modern celebrity signatures at low prices ('viele Autogramme schon ab 0,50 Euro', MdB cards at 50 cent): TV series cast (Sturm der Liebe, Marienhof, Lindenstraße), pop and sports figures, signed photo cards and magazine pictures (e.g. signed magazine picture EUR 59.95); a few historical politicians are included but the catalogue is modern celebrity memorabilia, not antiques or historic documents.

LouisXV online shop (PlentyMarkets/Ceres store, hotline +49 2306 9333 71): newly made furniture in historic style. Home page: 'Original baroque furniture reconstructed', 'Baroque to Art Nouveau original replica', '3000 basic article 100000 variants', 'as a wholesaler we offer best conditions', customisable colour/patina/fabric/dimensions on request, 50% prepayment. Reproductions, not antiques.

Kamorka Vintage Furniture (Viktar Bakun, Schivelbeiner Str. 19, 10439 Berlin; Tilda site): about 41 available Czechoslovak mid-century pieces (Jiroutek, Navrátil, Haerdtl, Požár, mostly 1960s) restored in the Berlin workshop, but the shop has a dedicated 'Redesign' section and filter and several listed pieces are redesigned/repainted items 'im neuen bunten Mid-Century Design' / 'mit handbemaltem Muster' / 'im neuen Design mit 3D Fassaden' (about 5 of 41 available items, roughly 12%); the Redesign page says vintage objects 'ohne besonderen historischen Wert' are re-interpreted. Several pieces are stocked in Prague. Vintage/new (upcycled) mix.

Feine Jagdwaffen (Firma Norbert Wenninger, Frankfurt, USt-IdNr. DE217301791) is a general luxury/second-hand and hunting-goods dealer: firearms (Flinten, Büchsen, Kurzwaffen, Ordonnanzwaffen), fly-fishing rods (some unfished), used Rolex watches, Hermès/Chanel/Dior handbags, Oldtimer cars, wine rarities, hunting accessories and a small 'Antiquitäten/Sonstiges' section. Broad mixed modern luxury and weapon stock without antique focus.

Eisenbahn-Sammlershop (hosted shop system): beside the 'Bücherantiquariat' (4,668 items, incl. Reprint Archiv Verlag reprints) the catalogue has a dedicated 'Verlagsneu' section (367 new publisher titles from Eisenbahn-Kurier, GeraMond, Kenning, Lok Report ...), current monthly magazine issues (Eisenbahn-Journal, MIBA, Der Modelleisenbahner), calendars and model-railway books; model railways are out of scope. New-goods section and reprints.

Münzen-Versandhaus Emporium-Hamburg (Shopware shop 'Münzkurier'): mail order of new coin issues - Euro and D-Mark commemoratives, 'Zukünftige Münz-Ausgaben' pre-orders, Disney/Star Wars/Harry Potter coins, gift ideas, Anlagemünzen, accessories, sale; the 'Historisch' category is only one of eight top categories. Predominantly new-issue and investment coins.

Violinorum is a WordPress community portal for string players ('Treffpunkt für Streicher'): teacher and conservatory directories, a user 'Marktplatz' (90 posts) and classified ads (Inserate) from several different sellers, lexicon and blog. No own stock; multi-seller directory/classifieds.

Briefmarken Ralf Schumann (Elchingen, hosted Malisto shop, 1,855 stamp items plus coins, postcards and accessories): stock is mainly post-1945 philately and current issues - Bund/Berlin Jahrbücher and Ersttagsblätter 1976-2016 'postfrisch komplett', Liechtenstein year sets 2012/2013, 'Gültige Frankaturware' (currently valid postage), Kiloware, plus a 'Zubehör' category; no antique focus.

The Vintage Club (Kim Sylvia Dombrowski, Hamburg): antique/vintage furniture repainted by hand in the owner's workshop ('von Hand veredelt', e.g. Louis-Philippe-Kommode in Grautönen und Gold EUR 899, Barock-Sekretär in Schwarz und Gold EUR 799) plus a commissioned painting service for customers' own furniture. Upcycled/painted shabby-chic decor furniture ('Antik. Neu gedacht'), not original antiques in their historical state.

KistenJack (WooCommerce shop): newly made 'Vintage'-style furniture and decor - upcycled oil drums, wooden crates, solid-wood tables, garden decor, personalised industrial-style gifts, candle holders, pictures, made-to-order crates, plus holiday apartments. Self-manufactured new goods, not antiques or genuine vintage.

Vintagesammler.de (Izolda Szlesinska-Sodar, Herleshausen): the imprint states the pages rest on private initiative to present vintage items from the owner's own collection; 'Eine mögliche Anfrage oder Verkauf erfolgt unter privaten Bedingungen', viewing by appointment only. Online gallery of single items without a shop; private collection, not a trading dealer.

Walters Vintage Werkstatt (Esther and Peter Walter, Marktstraße 13, 76726 Germersheim; craft business, Kleinunternehmer): vintage furniture, technology (consoles, radios, lamps) and curiosities. The own site has no catalogue; current stock is sold 'in unserem Laden, auf eBay, Catawiki (auction platform) und künftig im WhatsApp-Katalog' and Kleinanzeigen, plus workshops/events, repairs and 'kreative Umgestaltung' of furniture. Marketplace/auction-platform-only online stock with a mixed general vintage scope: owner decision.

Möbel Weidner (Thomas Weidner, Hahnbach): 'Individuelle Möbel ... moderne, ökologische Möbel, handgemacht nach Maß' - furniture produced to order from new solid wood and recycled teak in retro, modern, industrial, shabby and Landhaus styles, custom colours and dimensions ('Match-Center'). Newly made furniture, not antiques; 'Vintage Furniture since 1979' refers to the style label.

Antik & Design (Inhaber Gunter Scheible, Goetheplatz 1, 71638 Ludwigsburg): store with about 100 pieces on 200 sqm shown only as photos (no itemised or priced online catalogue), plus 'Maßanfertigung' of new furniture and kitchens from at least 100-year-old wood ('Cousine Laurent - maßgeschneidert aus antikem Holz', 'Bibliothek Charles'), lamps and an interior-design line (q84). decision.basis: Phaleristik-Shop-Dresden (Marco Großmann, Hospitalstraße 13, 01097 Dresden). Owner rule 2026-11-26: reproductions and made-to-order new pieces are excluded.

This is ordinary second-hand/costume fashion jewellery without qualified antique or collectible stock, so it falls outside the specialist antiques scope; orders go through an enquiry form ('Schreiben Sie mir').

Phönix Schöner Leben presents itself as 'Einrichtungshaus für hochwertige Möbel' with Einrichtungsberatung, Ausstellung, Ateliers, Referenzen, a printed Wohnjournal/catalogue (Herbst/Winter 2026) and a WooCommerce shop; the lead product is a porcelain bowl offered under 'Einrichtung'. It is a furnishing house selling new furniture and home accessories, not an antique dealer.

Antik Möbel - Familie Wocadlo, 35066 Frankenberg runs a WooCommerce collection at wocadlo.de/fw/shop (102 objects; chests, cabinets and chests of drawers from the Renaissance to Biedermeier with prices such as a Renaissance chest c.1650 at 2.550 EUR, plus some oil paintings), but the shop publishes no Impressum, no contact page, no phone or email, no terms and no shipping or collection information (the only hint is 'Vereinbaren Sie einen Termin zur Besichtigung'). The domain root and its /geo pages belong to an unrelated geocaching tour business, so no legal operator or contact for the antiques shop can be confirmed. No auction and no contemporary-art finding. Revisit when a legal notice or contact appears.

Kunsthandel Puch (Galerie V. Puch, Martin Viktor Puch, Bachweg 16, 82041 Oberhaching; imprint +49 (0)89 613 23 69, fax +49 (0)89 613 38 52, info@kunsthandel-puch.de, USt DE 130088842; WooCommerce catalogue; showroom Monday to Friday 11-18, Saturday 9-14 by prior phone appointment) trades old Russian and Greek icons, Gothic to Baroque sculpture, paintings of the 16th to 19th century and Kunsthandwerk. Object pages give origin, age, size and previous owner and carry 'VERKAUFT' markers, but show no price: 'Send an email request'. The FAQ says delivery costs depend on size, value and destination. Genuine antique dealer, no auction, no contemporary art, but no inspectable priced stock, so it is deferred as a price-on-request gallery (owner may decide to admit such galleries); sister catalogue site ikonen-galerie.com is recorded the same way.

Zalias is a Shopify retailer of new consumer electronics and home products (Lyndahl speakers and amplifiers, cables, HDMI and network accessories, loupe lamps, car and antenna accessories) and of newly made globes under its own brand Magellan-Expedition ('antike Globen' is a collection of decorative new globes). New-goods retail, no antique stock.

Zomorrodi Teppiche (Shopify shop; family carpet business in Nordrhein-Westfalen with a new second branch in Düsseldorf) sells '1001 handgemachte Teppiche', mostly newly made hand-knotted and designer carpets (Designer Teppiche, Modernes & Abstraktes, Gabbeh, Kinderteppiche, Kelim Kissen, upcycling) and a smaller old/antique/vintage section (collections alt-antik, vintage-teppich, alte-und-antike-kelims). The new carpet collections dominate the catalogue, so it is a new/old mix (owner decision 2026-11-26).

2nd home (Shopify) describes itself in its header as 'Dein Marktplatz für Vintage Möbel & Deko - Kuratiert durch 2nd home' and runs pages for selling your own furniture through the platform ('Bei 2nd home verkaufen', 'Fragen und Antworten zum Verkauf mit 2nd home'); products carry a vendor/brand 'Anbieter' (Cassina, Domus, Dietiker ...) and the range includes IKEA vintage and mass-market glassware. A self-described marketplace for used design goods, not a dealer selling its own stock; legal operator was not needed for the decision.

Musikinstrumente Ankauf Berlin (Geschäftsführer Ercan Rumanli, Marienfelder Allee 218, 12279 Berlin, 0177 79 79 187, USt DE2150001017) is a buying and repair service for violins, cellos, guitars, accordions and other used instruments ('Ankauf & Verkauf von Musikinstrumenten seit 1985', shop visits by appointment). The site is a one-page buying advert with Kontakt and Impressum only: no sales catalogue, prices or basket, and the instruments are ordinary used instruments. No inspectable stock.

Schmidt Gold (Marco Schmidt Goldankauf, Heidelberg and Altlußheim, info@schmidt-gold.de) is a gold, silver, coin and watch buying service ('Goldankauf Heidelberg', Bewertung, Ankauf, Nachlass; Altgold, Zahngold, Barren, Münzen, Tafelsilber). The pages only advertise purchasing; there is no sales catalogue or basket.
